name: ContentStudio
description_en:
ContentStudio is a hosted social media operations platform combining content creation, scheduling, client workspaces, approvals, automation, analytics and an inbox. It supports a workflow in which an editor prepares channel-specific content, reviewers decide whether it can proceed, and a publishing team follows the outcome in Planner. AI generation sits within that workflow rather than independently establishing content accuracy or business results.

Its useful evaluation boundary is the entire publishing process, not merely a list of network logos. Social queues, content categories, Evergreen campaigns and RSS automation feed schedules in different ways. Direct API publishing and mobile-notification publishing also have different completion semantics. This profile examines those distinctions for a small team or agency evaluating repeatable operations, without claiming a tested improvement in engagement, productivity or revenue.
description_zh:
ContentStudio 是托管社交媒体运营平台，结合内容创作、排程、客户工作区、审批、自动化、分析及收件箱。其流程可由编辑准备渠道专属内容、审阅者决定是否继续、发布团队在 Planner 跟踪结果。AI 生成位于流程内部，不能独立证明内容准确或业务效果。

有效评估边界是完整发布过程，不能只看网络标志列表。Social Queue、内容分类、Evergreen 活动及 RSS 自动化以不同方式填充排程。API 直接发布与移动通知发布的完成含义也不同。本文面向评估可重复运营的小团队或代理机构分析这些区别，未声称实测提升互动、效率或收入。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep a brand’s accounts, media, team and settings together.
core_features.explanation_zh: 集中同一品牌账户、媒体、团队及设置。

core_features.explanation_en: Each level uses Anyone or Everyone before progression.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每级按 Anyone 或 Everyone 规则继续。

core_features.explanation_en: Publish configured post variations in a looping sequence.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按循环序列发布配置的内容变体。

core_features.explanation_en: New feed items can publish, queue or enter a category.
core_features.explanation_zh: 新订阅项可发布、排队或进入分类。

en: Coordinate an editor/client approval chain across brand workspaces.
Recycle durable educational posts with deliberate variations and end dates.
Feed owned editorial updates into a controlled social queue.
zh: 跨品牌工作区协调编辑／客户审批链。
用经审变体及结束日期循环常青教育内容。
把自有资讯导入受控社交队列。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

steps.en: Create the client workspace with its timezone and permissions.
steps.zh: 建立客户工作区及时区、权限。

steps.en: Choose a queue or category and prepare destination-specific content.
steps.zh: 选择队列或分类，准备目的地专属内容。

steps.en: Select and exercise the intended approval chain.
steps.zh: 选择并检查目标审批链。

steps.en: Use controlled publication checks for API or mobile completion.
steps.zh: 针对 API 或移动完成方式做可控发布检查。

steps.en: Monitor failed posts and webhook delivery logs before replay.
steps.zh: 重放前检查失败帖及 webhook 投递日志。

items.en: Reconnecting a social account does not retry its failed posts.
items.zh: 重连社交账户不会重试失败帖子。

items.en: Active Evergreen content cannot accept new posts without stopping and restarting.
items.zh: 活动 Evergreen 添加帖子需停止再重启。

items.en: Mobile Published status can depend on the user confirming completion.
items.zh: 移动 Published 状态可能依赖用户确认完成。

items.en: Webhook delivery and API work share capacity; failure replay is unverified.
items.zh: Webhook 投递与 API 共享额度，失败重放未核实。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Standard $29 monthly or $19/month paid $228 annually: 5 accounts, 1 workspace/user. Advanced $69 monthly or $49/month paid $588 annually: 10 accounts, 2 workspaces/users. Agency Unlimited $139 monthly or $99/month paid $1,188 annually: starts at 25 social accounts, unlimited users/workspaces, not unlimited social accounts. Enterprise is quoted. API-focused annual-selected offer shows $15/month paid $180/year. Seven-day no-card trial; no permanent free plan. Add-ons, AI/API allowances and taxes affect cost. Expired-subscription data is retained up to 90 days. Exact API slider selection and full refund eligibility were not confirmed.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Standard 月付 $29，或年付 $228、每月折合 $19：5 账户、1 工作区／用户。Advanced 月付 $69，或年付 $588、折合 $49：10 账户、2 工作区／用户。Agency Unlimited 月付 $139，或年付 $1,188、折合 $99：25 社交账户起、用户／工作区不限，并非社交账户不限。Enterprise 询价。API 专项年付选中报价每年 $180、折合 $15。7 天免卡试用，无永久免费计划。附加项目、AI／API 额度及税影响成本。订阅过期数据最多保留 90 天。未确认 API 滑块准确选择及全部退款资格。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Start with a brand workspace and its timezone
sections.title_zh: 先建立品牌工作区及时区
sections.en: A workspace groups social accounts, Planner, media, automation and settings. Creation selects its timezone and Super Admin. Admin/Super Admin roles manage it; accounts cannot simply move to another workspace and must be reconnected. Deletion permanently removes posts, media and analytics. Editorial setup: establish the correct client boundary before importing a schedule, and check the purchased workspace count rather than reading the help page’s “as many as needed” as unlimited entitlement.
sections.zh: 工作区集中社交账户、Planner、媒体、自动化及设置，创建时选择时区与 Super Admin。Admin／Super Admin 管理工作区，账户不能直接移入另一工作区，需重新连接。删除会永久移除帖子、媒体及分析。编辑设置建议：导入排程前先确定客户边界，按购买的工作区数量核对，不能把帮助页“按需多个”理解为不限量授权。

sections.title_en: A queue needs content, while a category adds a theme
sections.title_zh: 队列需要内容，分类增加主题组织
sections.en: A Social Queue is an account-specific weekly posting schedule; posts must be added before it can publish them. Category queues organize themed content across multiple accounts, and one post belongs to only one category at a time. Both can coexist. Editorial example: keep a product-update category separate from the account’s general queue, then inspect the resulting calendar. A category is not evidence that every queued item has completed approval or that conflicting schedules automatically deduplicate.
sections.zh: Social Queue 是单账户的每周发布时刻，必须先加入内容才会发布。分类队列按主题跨多个账户组织，一帖同时仅属一个分类。两者可并用。编辑示例：把产品更新分类与账户普通队列分开，再检查生成日历。加入分类不能证明完成审批，也不能证明冲突排程自动去重。

sections.title_en: Choose approval rules for the actual decision process
sections.title_zh: 按真实决策过程选择审批规则
sections.en: Saved workflows contain ordered review levels; Anyone advances after one assigned approval, while Everyone needs all. A workflow saved only as Draft is unavailable in Composer. A default is preselected when using the workflow tab, not evidence every publication route is forced through it. The separate decision guide says one rejection overrides Everyone approvals; for Anyone, rejection must precede approval or the post is scheduled. Approvers can reschedule overdue unreviewed posts. Editorial launch plan: use a chain for distinct editorial and client decisions, and confirm timing before treating an approved item as ready for its original time.
sections.zh: 已保存流程包含按序审阅级别；Anyone 一人批准即可继续，Everyone 需要全部批准。仅存为 Draft 的流程在 Composer 不可用。默认流程在使用相应页签时预选，不能证明所有发布途径都强制经过它。决策指南另说 Everyone 任一拒绝覆盖批准，Anyone 拒绝必须早于批准，否则帖子进入排程。审阅者可重排已过期未审帖。编辑发布建议：分别建立编辑与客户决策级别，并确认时间后再认为已批准内容仍适合原时刻。

sections.title_en: Evergreen loops through variations before the next post
sections.title_zh: Evergreen 先发布变体，再进入下一帖
sections.en: An Evergreen campaign requires at least two posts. It publishes all variations of the first, then the second and subsequent posts, before another cycle; a cycle gap pauses between complete loops. AI-generated variations append to existing ones instead of replacing them. Editing requires pause/stop, and adding posts to an active campaign requires stop, change and restart. Editorial example: use durable tips with an end date for time-sensitive offers, and review every generated variation before activation. The document does not establish that stopping retracts previously published content.
sections.zh: Evergreen 至少需要两帖。先发布第一帖全部变体，再第二帖及后续内容，之后进入新循环；Cycle Gap 是完整循环之间的暂停。AI 新变体追加，不替换已有内容。编辑需要暂停／停止，向活动流程添加帖子需停止、修改、重启。编辑示例：常青技巧可持续使用，限时优惠设置结束日期，并在激活前审阅每个生成变体。文档不能证明停止会撤回已发布内容。

sections.title_en: RSS automation follows feed detection and a delivery choice
sections.title_zh: RSS 自动化按订阅检测及投递选择运行
sections.en: A campaign selects feed URLs, category and destinations. Captions can use source titles/URL, meta description or AI, with the AI option consuming credits. Delivery choices are immediate after detection, Social Queue or Content Category; the FAQ describes checks every 30 minutes, not guaranteed instant source publication. History and on/off controls are available. Editorial newsletter-to-social example: verify the source feed and link rights, inspect caption quality and choose queueing when human review is still required. A feed existing does not grant redistribution rights.
sections.zh: 活动选择 feed URL、分类及目的地。说明文字可用标题／URL、元描述或 AI，AI 消耗点数。投递可选择检测后立即发送、Social Queue 或 Content Category；FAQ 描述每 30 分钟检查，并非源内容发布即刻到达保证。提供历史及启停控制。编辑资讯转社交示例：核对订阅及链接使用权，检查文字质量，仍需人工审阅时选择排队。存在 feed 不授予再分发权。

sections.title_en: A notification is an instruction to publish, not the publication
sections.title_zh: 通知是发布提示，不是发布本身
sections.en: The iOS notification route hands media and a copied caption to the user, who completes the action inside Instagram. On return, ContentStudio asks whether publication actually happened; a positive answer changes Planner to Published. Notification Sent tracks reminders awaiting confirmation. Editorial acceptance: compare the native post with the intended account, content and timestamp before confirming. This self-reported state cannot independently prove delivery. A separate direct-publishing requirements article contains restrictive account/Story rules and legacy IGTV references; exact current format eligibility requires further account/provider verification.
sections.zh: iOS 通知途径把媒体及复制的说明交给用户，在 Instagram 内完成操作。返回后 ContentStudio 询问是否实际发布，肯定回答会把 Planner 改为 Published。Notification Sent 跟踪等待确认的提醒。编辑验收建议：确认前核对原生帖子账户、内容及时间。自行确认状态不能独立证明投递。另一直接发布要求文章含较严格账户／Story 规则及旧 IGTV 引用，准确现行格式资格仍需账户／平台核验。

sections.title_en: Reconnect first, then deliberately recover failed posts
sections.title_zh: 先重连，再有意恢复失败帖子
sections.en: Planner’s Failed filter exposes the reason. Fix an expired connection or invalid media, then Retry or Edit/reschedule. Reconnection alone does not automatically retry failures. The FAQ claims Retry avoids duplication if the post actually published, while still recommending checking the platform first; that is documented behavior, not an independently verified exactly-once guarantee. Editorial incident response: inspect the real destination and failure reason before replaying a launch message, preserve the intended publication window, and avoid deleting a failed record until its content is no longer needed.
sections.zh: Planner 的 Failed 筛选展示原因。修复过期连接或无效媒体后，再 Retry 或编辑／重排。仅重连不会自动重试。FAQ 声称已实际发布时 Retry 不重复，但仍建议先查看原生平台；这是文档行为，未独立验证仅一次保证。编辑故障处理建议：重放发布消息前检查真实目的地及失败原因，确认原定发布窗口，并在不再需要内容后才删除失败记录。

sections.title_en: Webhook success spends the same quota as API work
sections.title_zh: Webhook 成功投递消耗同一 API 额度
sections.en: Public webhooks send signed JSON for post lifecycle and comment events. The receiver should validate x-contentstudio-signature, return 2xx and inspect delivery logs showing sent payload and response. Up to five webhooks are allowed per account; each successful delivery consumes one request from the shared API pool. Rotating the secret invalidates the old one immediately. The failed-delivery FAQ describes logging, without establishing automatic retries or replay. Editorial integration plan: test one controlled event, check the response and budget notifications together with publishing API calls.
sections.zh: 公开 webhook 对帖子生命周期及评论事件发送签名 JSON。接收端应验证 x-contentstudio-signature、返回 2xx，并检查展示请求与响应的投递日志。每账户最多五个 webhook，成功投递一次消耗共享 API 池的一次请求。更新签名密钥立即使旧密钥失效。失败 FAQ 描述记录日志，未确定自动重试／重放。编辑集成建议：测试一个可控事件、核对响应，并把通知与发布 API 共同纳入额度预算。

sections.title_en: Budget for the operational features you need
sections.title_zh: 按所需运营能力做预算
sections.en: Standard covers basic publishing; Advanced explicitly adds inbox, approvals, Evergreen, RSS, bulk CSV and reports. An API-focused plan is separately offered and should not be assumed to include the full team suite. Editorial comparison: count brands, profiles, reviewers, automation sources and reporting recipients, then verify the selected package. A team needing repeated client review is a different purchase from a solo editor queueing one brand. Unlimited posting does not remove provider restrictions, AI credits or API quotas.
sections.zh: Standard 覆盖基础发布，Advanced 明确增加收件箱、审批、Evergreen、RSS、CSV 及报告。另售 API 专项计划，不能假设包含完整团队套件。编辑比较建议：统计品牌、社交档案、审阅者、自动化来源及报告接收者，再核对所选组合。需要反复客户审阅的团队与单编辑单品牌排队是不同购买需求。不限帖子不能取消平台限制、AI 点数或 API 额度。

seo.title_en: ContentStudio workflows: approvals, Evergreen and failed publishing
seo.title_zh: ContentStudio 流程：审批、Evergreen 及发布失败
seo.description_en: Inspect ContentStudio queues, approval precedence, Evergreen loops, mobile confirmation, webhook quota and current pricing.
seo.description_zh: 核对 ContentStudio 队列、审批先后、Evergreen 循环、移动确认、webhook 额度及当前价格。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate ContentStudio social publishing operations and package fit
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: The combined Instagram publishing guide was empty; exact current direct-publishing account, Story and media capabilities were not reconciled with older restrictive documentation.
research_gaps.zh: 综合 Instagram 发布指南无正文，未协调较旧限制文档与准确现行直接发布账户、Story 及媒体能力。

research_gaps.en: Provider token expiry, webhook retry/replay, request idempotency, RSS deduplication and queued-content behavior after pausing billing remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 平台令牌过期、webhook 重试／重放、请求幂等、RSS 去重及暂停账单后队列行为未核实。

research_gaps.en: The machine-readable pricing link failed; API offer slider selection and complete contract/refund conditions were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 机器可读定价链接失败，API 报价滑块选择及完整合约／退款条件未核实。

research_gaps.en: Source licence, self-hosting, exact UI-language list, regional service availability and independent quality/security/performance measurement were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实源码许可、自托管、准确界面语言清单、地区服务可用性及独立质量／安全／性能测量。
